description: Rich CH4/air flame (phi = 1.15) on the LPI flat porous burner with a N2 co-flow, axisymmetric, laminar, in the relaxational oscillation regime; reactingCanteraLMFoam with standard chemistry. The states are the developed flame, not streams.
deltaTFrom: the time step the run took at t = 0.031 (uniform/time: 1.21e-5), Courant-limited
statesFrom: an OpenFOAM run at t = 0.031 s, 0.05 mm mesh of 86688 cells: tools/states_from_openfoam.py, 2048 cells by ranks. There are no streams, and tools/make_initial_states.py leaves the case alone
